summary.text: Thomas Murphy, an independent write-in candidate who campaigned as 'BRAVE 2026 - Murphy for Kentucky' under the slogan 'Parties are the Problem,' lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. Senate seat in Kentucky to Andy Barr, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
His campaign website directed voters to write in his name and gave no biographical details; no profile of his education, career or prior offices was found.

sources.title: United States Senate election in Kentucky, 2026
